name: Wei Zhang
bio: Wei Zhang's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a family legacy or childhood fascination, but a vocational training program focused on precision painting and finishing. His meticulous nature and steady hand quickly set him apart. He joined Praga Racing a decade ago, initially as an assistant, but his dedication and eye for detail saw him rise to a specialist role. Wei believes the perfect paint job is more than aesthetics; it's a statement of quality and commitment, reflecting the team's overall pursuit of excellence. He is known for his ability to perfectly match colors and finishes even under extreme pressure, ensuring the cars not only perform well but look impeccable.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped, with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a wiry build, often seen wearing safety glasses pushed up on his forehead.

quirks: Always organizes his tools in a specific order before starting work.
Has a habit of humming traditional Chinese melodies while working, especially when concentrating.
Insists on using a specific brand of microfiber cloth for the final polish.
